text:
leah (sales): Hi @maria, quick check before I send the POC docs. You noted SAML via Okta, SCIM limited to two groups (eng + ops), RBAC mapping for tenant_admin, domain ownership verification, and KMS for keys. Anything else?

maria (customer): That's it. Also we need a clear list of required fields for SCIM and an estimate for a 3-week Dedicated POC cost.

omar (solutions): We can do 3-week Dedicated. Ballpark pricing: $15k for reserved capacity for 3 weeks (discounted). I'll follow up with a line-item quote. For SCIM we need the token + sample group names.

raj (eng): Engineering notes:
- SCIM supports filter: /Groups?filter=displayName%20eq%20"eng"
- Rate limit 10r/s during eval; request backoff on 429s
- We support deprovision on group remove and custom attribute mapping to roles
- For SAML: provide metadata XML or ACS/EntityID.

tess (security): We'll attach SOC2 summary and pen-test redacted report. For KMS in Dedicated we support customer-managed keys (bring-your-own-kms) with an addendum. @maria: confirm no sensitive PII stored.

maria (customer): Correct, only emails + hashed ids. We'll provide Okta metadata and SCIM token today. We'll do DNS TXT for domain proofing.

leah (sales): Actions: 1) Maria send Okta metadata + SCIM token + group list. 2) Omar to send formal quote and PO template. 3) Raj to prepare a short onboarding runbook and test endpoint. 4) Tess to lift SOC2 docs and start questionnaire.

omar (solutions): I'll include a sample SAML config snippet and a DNS TXT example in the quote: add TXT _redwood_verify=mnfrx-xy12

raj (eng): Example SCIM test curl (we'll PM the base URL): curl -X POST "https://scim.redwood.example.com/v2/Users" -H "Authorization: Bearer <SCIM_TOKEN>" -d '{"userName":"joe@mnfrx.com"}'

tess (security): sec-bot create MNFRx-POC-SecQ ticket and mark owner tess (security).

sec-bot: Ticket MNFRx-POC-SecQ created. Link: https://redwood-secure.example.com/tickets/MNFRx-POC-21

maria (customer): Thanks all. We'll aim to have metadata + DNS TXT done today and confirm the PO tomorrow.

leah (sales): Great, scheduling a 30min kickoff tomorrow 9am PT.
